analysis.summary: The contract, signed February 2, 2026, sets a $2,400 price for replacing the deck and applying two coats of stain, and says changes must be agreed in writing. The invoice dated March 12, 2026 totals $2,800, including a $400 line for a third coat, and the texts show you disputing it, paying $2,200 under protest on March 18, and Dale replying 'Not giving that back' on March 19. The contract, invoice, and receipt all show a $600 deposit, while your description says $500. The invoice lists a business address of 2150 Alder Creek Rd, Sacramento, although you say Ridgeline has moved and you don't know where it does business; the move rests only on your word. No document shows whether any approval of a third coat was given, and the six-week overdue period is not stated in any document.
